name: robots/gsilano__crazys
title: CrazyS Crazyflie 2.0 simulator
intro: CrazyS Crazyflie 2.0 simulator, adapted from gsilano/crazys. It reads `read_odometry`; runs `publish_attitude_thrust`. `publish_attitude_thrust`: publish a roll/pitch/yaw-rate/thrust setpoint on the Crazyflie command topic; publication is fire-and-forget and does not confirm flight or stopping. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/robots/gsilano__crazys --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/robots/gsilano__crazys --backend fake --mcp
